plainLanguage: Eight company-related PAC and federal award recipients are mapped as separate source-backed records. Two include substantial legal-entity or award-type comparability gaps. No improper influence is established.

politicalMetric.definition: FEC category total contributions to other committees, reported during different partial 2025–26 cycle cutoffs; includes recipient committee types beyond candidates, excludes other PAC disbursements; not corporate treasury spending.

independentGiving: Corporate giving, employee-funded PACs, independent spending, trade association funds, dark money and lobbying must remain distinct financial streams.
awardDefinition: A federal award or obligated contract action is not revenue, cash paid, profit, a new competitive win, or a causal result of giving.
method: Record specific FEC committee identifiers alongside exact Treasury recipient UEIs, flagging that parent, subsidiary, PAC sponsor and recipient may be distinct. One Amazon PAC value uses a secondary FEC-derived extract and is visibly labeled pending FEC reconciliation.

entries.name: CoreCivic, Inc.
entries.nextStep: Source exact UEI contract action series; compare GEO and CoreCivic with 2024–25 detention-demand and occupancy controls
entries.limits: Companywide revenue reflects federal, state and local contracts, reactivations and occupancy. Neither aggregate PAC nor 2025 political contributions establish an influence effect.

pac.committeeName: CORECIVIC, INC. POLITICAL ACTION COMMITTEE (CORECIVIC PAC)

entries.name: Lockheed Martin
entries.nextStep: Track F-35 and space contracts at award ID plus subcontractors; obtain lobbying and agency budget series
entries.limits: Parent UEI aggregates may differ from contract operating subsidiaries. Not all FEC payments in this category are direct candidate contributions.

pac.committeeName: LOCKHEED MARTIN CORPORATION EMPLOYEES' POLITICAL ACTION COMMITTEE

entries.name: The Boeing Company
entries.nextStep: Audit DoD awards and reprogramming; keep child UEI award separate from parent UEI totals
entries.limits: Illustrative award's child UEI is different from parent. Contract is not proof of donation-related treatment.

entries.name: General Dynamics
entries.nextStep: Trace submarines, surface ships, ammunition and IT awards; control for long-lived multiyear budgets
entries.limits: The company states employee PAC contributions are voluntary, and corporate treasury generally does not fund candidates. Multi-year procurement timing confounds before/after correlations.

pac.committeeName: GENERAL DYNAMICS CORPORATION POLITICAL ACTION COMMITTEE (GENERAL DYNAMICS EMPLOYEE PAC)

entries.name: RTX Corporation
entries.industry: Defense, missile systems and aircraft propulsion
entries.nextStep: Separate Raytheon/Pratt & Whitney/Collins UEIs before aggregating group awards; reconcile FEC PAC spending and lobbying
entries.limits: The example is an aircraft-propulsion delivery order, not RTX parentwide results. Parent identifier is not interchangeable with this operating recipient.

pac.committeeName: EMPLOYEES OF RTX CORPORATION POLITICAL ACTION COMMITTEE

entries.name: Microsoft Corporation
entries.nextStep: Reconcile federal software and cloud contracts with Microsoft legal recipients; analyze enterprise procurement and competition before assessing influence
entries.limits: Microsoft says corporate funds do not go directly to candidates; its employee/shareholder PAC is distinct. The identified UEI is one Microsoft child and some records have multiple reported parents.

pac.committeeName: MICROSOFT CORPORATION STAKEHOLDERS VOLUNTARY PAC - MSVPAC

corporatePolicy.statement: Microsoft states its company does not donate to candidates; the voluntary stakeholders PAC is a distinct employee/shareholder-supported committee.

entries.name: Amazon PAC / Amazon Web Services
entries.nextStep: Validate ownership and sponsor-AWS affiliation before aggregating Amazon.com Services PAC funds with AWS federal contracts; investigate government cloud awards and parent contracting UEIs
entries.limits: The FEC PAC's connected organization is Amazon.com Services LLC, while the Treasury recipient is Amazon Web Services Inc. Neither company spelling nor common branding proves an individual PAC-funded contract or a comparable legal-entity group.

pac.committeeName: AMAZON.COM SERVICES LLC SEPARATE SEGREGATED FUND (AMAZON PAC)

entries.name: Exxon Mobil Corporation
entries.nextStep: Separate grants and DOE funding reductions from competitively awarded procurement; map PAC money against legislation, leases and policy dates with clear matching controls
entries.limits: An official Treasury recipient record shows a negative financial-assistance action; it is neither a negative federal procurement contract nor companywide grant total. Energy permitting, subsidies and tax rules are different outcome classes.

pac.committeeName: EXXON MOBIL CORPORATION POLITICAL ACTION COMMITTEE (EXXONMOBIL PAC)

exampleAssistance.warning: Negative deobligation, not a new contract or an affirmative government benefit

knownGaps: FEC itemized PAC-to-candidate transfer amendments not fully reconciled
Full parent-and-subsidiary contract grouping by date and UEI not audited
No bidder and non-donor peer cohort
No award-vote-appropriation decision evidence joining donors to officials
No direct causal impact on federal contract growth or business profit
State and local award comparators not backfilled
Amazon's FEC PAC sponsor and AWS government contractor are legally distinct entities; ownership relationship and support cannot be inferred from brand names
Exxon grant deobligation and federal contract awards are different spending types; no subsidy-to-donation linkage
controls: Do not compare FEC PAC disbursement amounts as company dollars invested
Do not compare different FEC report cutoffs as standardized totals
Do not imply a single contract amount is company revenue
Contractor PAC and registered recipient IDs are not documented donor-to-contract paths
Company annual political activity must be dated before award before interpreting outcomes
Do not treat Amazon.com Services PAC and Amazon Web Services as a validated money or ownership path without audited corporate crosswalk
Do not show negative Treasury grants as negative contracts or government spending returns
